Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: credit for seats removed mid-cycle

Hi Soojin —

We removed 30 developer seats from our Dedicated pool on Aug 3rd (screenshot attached) but the invoice for Aug 1–31 still shows the full committed seat charge. Can you confirm how Redwood handles partial-month seat removals? We need either a pro-rated credit on the next invoice or a one-off refund; finance would prefer a credit.

I've attached the invoice and a screenshot from the admin console showing the change activity (Aug 3). Please confirm what you need from our side — VAT ID, PO, anything else?

Thanks,
Elena

Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 10:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: credit for seats removed mid-cycle

Hi Elena —

Thanks for the note and the attachments. Short answer: yes, we can apply a pro-rated credit for the unused seat-days from Aug 3–31. Two quick items so we process correctly:

- VAT/Tax: we need Epicore's VAT ID for issuance of a credit note (EU reverse-charge handling). Kimberly — can you confirm documentation needed and whether we should issue a credit note or a refund in this region?
- Allocation: Marcus — I think the simplest is daily-rate * seat-days removed, net of any committed minimums. I included a draft calc (credit_calc_draft.csv) and the billing ticket link below.

Elena — please confirm you want the credit applied to your Sep invoice (default) or an immediate refund to the payment method. Also share the VAT ID if available.

I'll loop in billing to cut the credit note once we agree.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Related: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-4832
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Elena Ramos <elena.ramos@epicore.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 13:28:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: credit for seats removed mid-cycle

Soojin / Elena —

I ran the numbers off the draft sheet you attached. Methodology: daily unit rate = (monthly committed seat price / 30) — we use 30-day standard for internal proration for simplicity — multiply by seat-days removed (30 seats * 29 days = 870 seat-days if removal on Aug 3rd counts entire day). That nets to a gross credit of EUR 14,610 before VAT.

VAT handling (Kimberly please confirm): since Epicore is EU-registered and provided B2B VAT ID, we should issue a credit note with zero-rated reverse-charge (no VAT collected on the credit). If we don't receive a VAT ID we need to gross up per local rules and potentially issue corrected invoice.

Operational notes:
- We'll apply the credit to the Sept invoice if Elena confirms.
- If Epicore needs a refund, finance will open a payment reversal (takes 5–7 business days).
- I'll prepare the credit note draft and attach within BILL-4832 for audit.

Kimberly — can you confirm the wording for the credit note (line item description)? Also confirm whether we need the PO reference.

Marcus Lin
Billing Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Attachments: credit_calc_draft.csv (spreadsheet)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 15:47:00 +0000

Hi Elena —

Thanks — we've got everything we need from our side except your VAT ID. Per Marcus the credit calculation is as follows: daily-rate (monthly seat price / 30) × 30 seats × 29 unused days = EUR 14,610 gross. We will issue a credit note for EUR 14,610.

Please confirm two things so we can proceed today:
1) Do you want the EUR 14,610 applied as a credit on the 2026-09 invoice, or issued as a refund to the card on file?
2) Please provide Epicore's VAT ID (if B2B EU registered) and PO reference (optional but helpful).

If we don't receive a VAT ID by end of day Wednesday Aug 18 we'll still issue the credit note but our tax team may need to make an adjustment if reverse-charge can't be applied.

Once you confirm I'll ask Marcus to post the credit note and we'll attach it to BILL-4832.

Best regards,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
